prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production background atlas for a portrait 2D party RPG.
Image 1 is the existing FOUR environment plates to replace. Image 2 is a COMPOSITION/CAMERA reference only, not art style, not characters or interface.
Replace image 1's four scenery plates with much simpler, flatter battle arenas. Keep the same dark fantasy painted illustration style, crisp textured stonework, midnight blue and warm amber light, but REMOVE the deep cinematic perspective and detailed distant vistas. Match image 2's slightly elevated, side-on 2D JRPG stage angle: an upright back wall across the TOP 24 percent of EACH plate and a broad flat unobstructed walkable stone floor covering the lower 76 percent. Horizontal stone courses, very shallow depth, no central vanishing point, no corridor receding into distance, no steep aerial map. The large quiet floor must fit 4 party sprites on left and 3 enemy sprites on right at the SAME SCALE anywhere between 35% and 90% plate height. Walls/torches should be drawn at sprite scale, not vast buildings. Ground uses restrained flat shading, broad flagstones, matte surfaces, minimal cracks, very little busy texture or shine. Character readability is the priority.
Exact output: 2048x3072 atlas, precise 2x2 grid with four 1024x1536 portrait plates, edge-to-edge no borders or gutters. All four have identical floor-plane camera and wall-to-floor boundary at 24% height.
TOP LEFT floor 1 Candle Hollows: small cave chamber with chunky blue stone rear wall, one stone arch doorway on the back wall, two warm torch sconces and small cave rock trims at far edges. Lower three quarters a simple flat slate flagstone battle floor. No river, distant castle, horizon or skulls.
TOP RIGHT floor 2 flooded road: low blue stone aqueduct parapet across back, a broken wagon wheel only at very back left; broad exposed matte stone paving, thin shallow blue water only at far edges, clear middle.
BOTTOM LEFT floor 3 stag checkpoint: low ancient masonry gateway across back, a pair of small blue-gold stag banners mounted on back wall, quiet flat broad stone courtyard covering lower three quarters.
BOTTOM RIGHT floor 4 four-door hall: four closed gothic doors in a straight blue stone back wall, sparse cobwebs in TOP corners; broad open matte flagstones, dark blue and restrained torchlight.
No people, creatures, character silhouettes, enemies, weapons, HUD, text, letters, health bars, buttons, cards or frames. No isolated platforms or floor obstacles. No excessive reflective glitter. This is EMPTY scenery only, compatible with existing separately rendered chibi pixel fantasy fighters. Keep art polished and coherent, with clear big shapes.
